6. What proportion of reads (both R1 and R2) were trimmed?

For SRR25630297, I had 12.2% of all read pairs had adapter contamination and needed trimming
For SRR25630381, I had 28.6% of all read pairs had adapter contamination and needed trimming

8. Bash command to develop trimmed read distribution files:
grep -A1 "@SRR" SRR25630381_1_paired.fastq | grep -v "@SRR" | grep -v "^--" | awk '{print(length($0))}'| sort -n| uniq -c | sort -g > 381_1_distribution.txt
I then manually added column labels at the top of each txt file

8. Comment on whether you expect R1s and R2s to be adapter-trimmed at different rates and why.
I don't expect a variation in trimming rates for the different reads, it just comes down to adapter contamination rates.
